literal: Why do the eyes themselves weep now, when they themselves showed us that which caused this unceasing pain?
translation: Why do my eyes weep now? It was they who showed me my lover, bringing upon me this unceasing pain of separation that I now suffer.
modern: தவிர்க்க முடியாத இந்தக் காம நோயை, அன்று அவர்களே காட்டி இன்று நாம் அனுபவிப்பதற்குக் காரணமான கண்கள், இப்போது தாமே அழுவது ஏனோ?
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine laments the distress of her eyes, which are weeping due to the pain of separation from her lover. She points out the irony of their tears: it was her eyes that eagerly looked upon her lover in the first place, initiating the love that led to this relentless affliction. Since the eyes themselves showed her the lover and invited this pain, she questions why they are now weeping as if they are innocent victims of their own actions.
